High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This is the first application seeking for suspension of sentence and bail filed on behalf of appellant Rajendra @ Dagna who has been convicted under Sections 376(Ka) of Indian Penal Code and sentenced to life imprisonment and fine of Rs.5,000/- and under Section 302 of Indian Penal Code and sentenced to life imprisonment and fine of Rs.5000/- with default stipulation vide impugned judgment dated 6.3.2019 passed by the Tenth Additional Sessions Judge, Gwalior in Sessions Trial No.493/2013.

The case of the prosecution is that on 18.6.2013 when the complainant came home from the market at around 1:00 in the afternoon, she found the door of her house was locked from inside, and shrieks of her mother (deceased) coming from the house and when the complainant looked from the window, appellant, who is her neighbour, was lying on the complainant's mother.
When the complainant screamed the appellant wore pants and went upstairs.
After that complainant kicked and opened the door and when the complainant immediatley went upstairs, she saw the appellant had jumped from the roof and was running towards the road.

When the complainant screamed,
Namita (PW.3) also came and she also told that the appellant had run away towards the road.
Then the complainant called 108 ambulance and took her mother to the Hospital at Morar and thereafter to J.A.Hospital where the complainant's mother died during treatment.

The complainant had seen appellant hitting her mother on head with a stick through the window, and on the basis of the complaint the FIR was registered by the complainant for the offence under Section 302, 376 of IPC at Crime No.232/2013 at Police Station Thatipur, Gwalior.
During the investigation, inquest panchnama and spot map were prepared, postmortem was performed, statements of the witnesses under section 161 of CrPC were recorded.
After necessary investigation charge sheet was filed.
After trial, the Trial Court convicted and sentenced the accused as indicated hereinabove.

sentences.text: It is averred in the application filed by the appellant that the Sessions Court has not appreciated the evidence placed on record in correct perspective.
The judgment suffers from surmises and conjectures.
Appellant has falsely been implicated in the instant case.
It has been further averred that there are contradictions and omissions in the statements of the material witnesses.
It has further been averred in the application that the learned Trial Court has committed an error in convicting and sentencing appellant for the alleged offence.
There is no likelihood of early hearing of the appeal in near future.
The appellant is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions that may be imposed by this Court while considering the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.
Per contra, State counsel has vehemently opposed the contentions stating that there is sufficient material available on record against the present appellant.
There is active participation of the present appellant in the commission of offence.
On these grounds, he has prayed for dismissal of the application.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the active participation of the present appellant in the commission of offence, no case for grant of bail is made out.
Accordingly, I.A. No.15465 of 2022 is hereby rejected.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (MILIND  CHIEF JUSTICE   (aspr)
